## Anas v5.2.1

- 主题设置将“跟随系统”简化为“系统”，为系统、浅色和深色选项分别添加显示器、太阳和月亮图标。
- 主题图标随界面字号缩放，保持图标与文字的尺寸协调。

- Simplified the Chinese system-theme label and added monitor, sun, and moon icons to the System, Light, and Dark options.
- Theme icons now scale with the interface font size to stay proportionate to their labels.
